name: hankintailmoitukset
description: Hilma (hankintailmoitukset.fi) is Finland's public procurement notice service. This CLI searches tender notices and procurement plans, fetches notice, procedure and plan details, browses CPV and NUTS codes, and reads statistics and Hilma announcements.

commands.name: search-notices
commands.summary: Full-text search of Hilma procurement notices and plans (Azure Search, Lucene syntax), with filter, sort and paging

params.name: query
params.description: Lucene query. The UI wraps each keyword as ((word OR word*)). Add CPV filters with AND cpvCodes:(9091*). Use * to match everything.

params.name: filter
params.description: OData filter. Contract notices: search.in(mainType, 'ContractNotices|NationalNotices', '|'). Only open ones: append ' and expirationDate ge 2026-10-18T00:00:00Z' (ISO datetime). Exclude procurement pl

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort order, e.g. 'datePublished desc', 'deadline desc', 'dateModified desc' (asc also allowed)

params.name: top
params.description: Results per page. The UI uses 75; the CSV export uses 1000.

commands.name: get-enotice
commands.summary: Get the full eForms notice detail (lots, buyer, criteria, deadlines) by procedureId and noticeId

commands.name: get-procedure
commands.summary: Get an eForms procurement procedure (overview and its notices) by procedureId

commands.name: get-procurement-plan
commands.summary: Get a procurement plan (upcoming procurement) by planId

params.name: planId
params.description: planId from search-notices results (plans have isPlan true)

commands.name: search-organisations
commands.summary: Search buyer organisations by name (used by the buyer filter)

params.name: query
params.description: Organisation name text (wildcards allowed, e.g. turku*)

commands.name: search-cpv
commands.summary: Autocomplete search of CPV procurement classification codes by name or code

params.name: query
params.description: CPV name or code fragment, e.g. siivous* or 9091*

commands.name: get-cpv-tree
commands.summary: Get the full hierarchical CPV code tree with labels (large response)

params.name: contractType
params.description: Contract type code; the UI sends 0

commands.name: get-nuts-tree
commands.summary: Get the NUTS region code tree used for location filters

commands.name: get-cms-ref
commands.summary: Get the current Prismic content ref, which the announcement commands need

commands.name: list-announcements
commands.summary: List public Hilma announcements and news, newest first

params.name: ref
params.description: Prismic content ref (from get-cms-ref, master ref)

params.name: lang
params.description: Content language: fi, en-gb or the Swedish locale

commands.name: get-announcement
commands.summary: Get one Hilma announcement by its uid

notes: search-notices is an Azure Cognitive Search index proxy that uses Lucene syntax.

Filter and sort in search-notices: keywords are written as ((word OR word*)); combine with AND cpvCodes:(9091*) for CPV filtering. Use the OData $filter param for type tabs and for 'open only' (expirationDate ge <current ISO time>). Sort with orderby.
Paging and export in search-notices: page with skip in steps of top. The UI's CSV export is the same query with top=1000.

Detail lookups from search-notices results: get-enotice takes procedureId and noticeId. get-legacy-procurement and list-legacy-procurement-notices take oldProcurementProjectId (when it is non-zero). get-procurement-plan takes planId.

Unverified examples: the examples for get-legacy-notice, get-legacy-procurement, list-legacy-procurement-notices and get-procurement-plan are placeholders because no concrete ids were captured. Take real ids from search-notices results.
Unverified params: the query param names for search-organisations and search-cpv (search, $top) are inferred from the sibling /search/eformnotices endpoint and were not recorded.
Prismic ref: the announcement commands need a current Prismic ref. If the default stops working, call get-cms-ref and pass the master ref.
Not covered: POST /web/api/enotices/linkingto (linked notices) is a read endpoint, but its body was not captured, so it is omitted.
No login is needed for any command.
